regions.merged_text: (March 27) God bless you Joseph J. O'Donnell - with Winnie and all your dear ones. As surmised when phoning last Sunday, I was set for your high Mass on Wednesday but that morning Fr. Guargian whispered to me a little change in schedule in your favor. "We'll offer the solemn Mass for the O'Donnell intentions next Sunday. Write them to that effect ... " I wanted to do so that day - and every day since and now its almost time for the daily "pick up" So I'll add our simple Easter greeting and felicitations with a hearty God's blessing to all repeated for all the Easter Season.
